text: {"findings":[{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Experiment under 14 days, no MDE/power, and randomization by customer","detail":"The test runs for only 1 week, below the 14-day minimum, and states no MDE or power calculation. Storm conditions are geographic, so randomizing by customer lets neighboring customers, drivers and routes cross arms, and the storm-only sample may be too small.","evidence_quote":"A/B test randomized by customer. Run for 1 week. Compare on-time rate between arms.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Run at least 14 days (long enough to capture sufficient storm events). Randomize by geographic zone or delivery region to avoid leakage between arms. Add an MDE and power analysis."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"Missing customer experience guardrails for wider promise windows","detail":"Widening promise windows changes the customer-facing promise, but the only guardrail is cost. There are no guardrails for customer satisfaction, conversion or cancellation rate, or for early or late delivery against the new promise.","evidence_quote":"Cost Per Delivery: must not increase.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Add guardrails such as checkout conversion, order cancellation rate, customer satisfaction/contact rate, and on-time rate against the original window."},{"type":"PRIOR_ART","title":"Prior experiment EXP-014 referenced without learnings","detail":"The proposal cites EXP-014 as a precedent but does not say what that experiment found or how those results shape this design. It only says this one applies during storms rather than permanently.","evidence_quote":"Follows EXP-014, but only applies during storms rather than permanently.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Summarize EXP-014's results (effect on on-time rate, conversion, cost) and explain how they inform this design and targets."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"Baseline figure and source are not verifiable","detail":"The 78% baseline is stated as fact with no source. The problem statement cites an analysis by name but gives no figures, link or date.","evidence_quote":"baseline 78%, target 88% within 8 weeks","citations":[],"recommendation":"Cite the data source, date range and query for the 78% baseline, and link the weather impact analysis."}]}
